notes: The page begins section 2, titled Le groupe S-double-hat-E. It describes elements by a tuple of a profinite unit p, a permutation sigma, and three elements of hat-pi, subject to a product condition and a generating condition.

Formula (3) gives the associated morphism on l_0, l_1, l_infinity. Formula (4) displays the canonical map to the labelled automorphism group. Formulas (5) and (6) give a map i, and (7) states that its composite with p is inner conjugation by g. Formula (8) records a multiplication rule. This is a transcription summary, not a proof verification.

The product condition (2) contains retraced indices. The apparent infinity forms in its last factor are retained as unresolved alternatives to zero; the expected cyclic sequence is not used to force a correction.
The multiplication sentence visibly names double-hat-E alone, although S-double-hat-E appears in the title and maps. The missing S is not silently supplied.
The marginal assertion ends with i(hat-pi), as both witnesses say. It is retained without enlarging its domain to the entire domain of i or asserting the mathematical claim is correct.

H records the earlier g_0 beneath the first g_infinity in (2), and the mapsto beneath equality in (3), in editorial notes. Those notes are treated as witness evidence of the same deletion states, not as H omissions merely because its display lacks the macros.
Only the assigned packet and current notation table were used. No OCR, outside text, external mathematical reference, or TeX compilation was used.

A new crop of the last word exposes a large partial curve below the word entering from the right edge. The final punctuation is therefore retained as a doubtful comma, rather than the initial half-based assumption of no comma.
